scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @platform/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @platform/api && npm run build --workspace @platform/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages prisma prisma.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @platform/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @platform/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @platform/web && tsc -p tsconfig.prisma.json
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
